=== HubSpot Company Record: Northstar AI (104388) ===

Summary
- Self-serve Hosted API account with sustained spend growth and increasing rate-limit friction.
- Routed via PLG signal pipeline to Sales for Dedicated expansion motion.
- Primary pain: repeated 429s during peak hours + inconsistent p95 latency when traffic spikes.
- They’re willing to consider Dedicated if we can give predictable throughput and a clear cost model.

Firmographics / context
- Domain: northstar.ai
- HQ: North America (team split: NYC + remote)
- Team size: ~120 (Eng-heavy)
- Product: customer support automation + internal agent for ticket triage and knowledge-base answers.

Signals that triggered routing (PLG → Sales)
- Spend growth: +~65% 30d vs prior 30d (still on self-serve Hosted API).
- Rate-limit friction: repeated 429s (7d window), plus “retry storms” observed in logs per their notes.
- Concurrency spikes: bursty traffic during business hours; they cited 4–6x spikes vs baseline.
- Intent: repeated pricing page visits + Dedicated docs clicks (Console).

Current usage (as described / inferred)
- Workload mix:
  - Chat completion for agent responses (streaming)
  - Embeddings for KB retrieval (daily rebuild + realtime queries)
- Model behavior:
  - Wants consistent fallback behavior when capacity constrained (they’ve seen occasional routing failures)
  - They’re sensitive to output regressions (support automation; “wrong answers are costly”)
- Latency targets (verbatim-ish): “We need p95 under 1.2s for the first token during peak, otherwise CS workflows back up.”

Product fit notes
- Dedicated looks like a fit if we can:
  - Remove 429s via reserved throughput
  - Provide predictable token/sec for peak periods
  - Keep API surface the same (minimal app changes)
- Optimize add-on may help them stabilize unit economics (batching + caching suggestions); Markus to review traces if they share.

Ownership / routing
- Owner (AE): Stephanie Nguyen
- SE: Markus Klein
- CSM (for expansion governance / suppression checks): Jasmine Liu
- Routing rationale: NA mid-market; self-serve → Dedicated expansion candidate.

Timeline (recent activity)
- 2025-02-18 — Company created in HubSpot from PLG signal routing (sustained spend + 429 friction). Sequence enrollment created for SDR follow-up.
- 2025-02-20 — SDR outreach initiated (signal-based): rate-limit pain + cost/perf tuning angle. (Sequence: “Rate-limit friction → Dedicated sizing offer”, vA).
- 2025-03-03 — Meeting booked via signal workflow. Gmail thread: thread_2025_03_03_meeting-booked-from-signal.
- 2025-03-04 — Discovery call held (AE + SE). Fireflies: ff_8f3c2a_plg-signal-followup-discovery.
- 2025-03-05 — Internal note: investigate duplicate outreach report (related pilot-wide dedupe issue; see SUP-1932). Confirmed Northstar received 2 touches from parallel tasks; stop-gap suppression applied + apologized.
- 2025-03-06 — Updated stage to Discovery; added preliminary Dedicated recommendation and next steps.

Call notes (ff_8f3c2a) — key points
- Northstar goal: scale support-agent feature to 3 enterprise customers over next quarter; expects step-function traffic.
- Pain points:
  - “We’re hitting rate limits right when our customers are busiest.”
  - “Latency gets spiky; we can’t have the agent wait around.”
- They currently do client-side retries; this amplifies bursts.
- Cost: they don’t want surprises; would accept commit if it buys predictability.
- Stakeholders:
  - Eng lead owns infra + reliability
  - Product owner for support automation signs off on quality
  - Security/IT will review SOC2 + retention and audit log posture before procurement

Open questions
- Exact peak QPS / concurrent requests (they gave directional numbers only).
- Token distribution and streaming usage patterns.
- Any strict data residency requirements (initially “no”, but they have EU customers—needs confirmation).

Tasks / playbook (created by workflow)
- Task: “Within 24h: send Dedicated sizing questionnaire + request 48h log sample” (Owner: Stephanie)
- Task: “Within 48h: SE proposes initial Dedicated pool size + scaling policy” (Owner: Markus)
- Task: “Within 72h: share security FAQ pack + SOC2 pointer; offer security review call” (Owner: Stephanie)
- Sequence: Enrolled (SDR) → paused after meeting booked; handoff to AE complete.

Next steps
- Markus to send a short sizing template (peak concurrency, avg tokens, max context, p95 requirements).
- Stephanie to send Mutual Action Plan (MAP) email with pilot outline (2 weeks) and proposed timeline.
- If they confirm procurement/security timeline, schedule 30-min security readiness call and pre-empt questionnaire.

Notes / hygiene
- Suppression: Ensure no additional SDR sequences enroll while active AE-owned opportunity is open.
- Dedupe incident: Northstar reported duplicate touch; tracked under SUP-1932 (pilot dedupe bug). Added manual cool-down tag for 14 days.
